}}'''Organization''' is a tier one [[technology]] that unlocks Harvest Fruit, which costs two [[stars]], produces one [[population]], and can only be performed on tiles with fruit. Organization also reveals crop, a resource used by the [[Farm]].

The [[Imperius]] tribe starts with Organization.

==Trivia==

*[[Zebasi|Zebasi's]] fruit was changed from red watermelons to orange cantaloupes in late 2019 to avoid potential concerns about [[Wikipedia:Watermelon stereotype|racism]].
*[[∑∫ỹriȱŋ|∑∫ỹriȱŋ's]] fruit is the only one which visually appears as just a single piece of fruit per tile.
